thread:
Ethan (Recruiter): Candidate for Sr PM (US) received a local counter. Wants earlier start (May 1) and asked if we can bridge equity grant to their counter proposal until comp panel completes review. Need to confirm by EOD so they can give notice.
Anya (People Ops): share redacted numbers and candidate deadline pls
Ethan (Recruiter): Offer: base $150k + 15% target, RSU grant in band = 10k units over 4y. Counter: wants RSU ~14k units and earlier start May 1 (original May 18). Also asks about pro-rated PTO and 401(k) match effective date.
Leah (Hiring Manager): This hire unblocks product roadmap. I can sign off on a provisional equity top-up as a one-time additional grant vesting schedule aligned to original offer, but need Comp & VP approval. We can also confirm earlier start if visa/benefits allow.
Maya (Comp): Policy note: equity exceptions allowed as provisional "bridging grant" but must be timeboxed and converted or revoked after final panel. Require written justification from manager + VP sign-off + Finance. Must document vesting and clawback if final grant differs. We typically do provisional grants for 60 days.
Legal: We need to add a clause about provisional grant being conditional on final award; include repayment/clawback wording and clarify tax withholding responsibility. Also confirm equity plan admin processes for revocation.
Finance: Payroll and equity accounting need timeline: if start May 1 and we issue provisional RSU, we must notify equity admin by cut-off. Also 401(k) match effective date depends on payroll enrollment window; may be next month. PTO proration standard applies.
offer-bot: Automated check: "Requested: provisional equity top-up + start date change + benefits proration info. Required approvers: comp@, vp-engi@, finance@, legal@. Suggested provisional window: 60 days. Candidate deadline: EOD"
Anya (People Ops): Drafting offer language proposal: keep base $150k, add provisional RSU one-time grant of 4k units (vesting per offer schedule) payable contingent on start; condition: final comp panel decision by 2026-07-01. Benefits notes: 401(k) enrollment processed first payroll after start, employer match effective next payroll cycle; PTO prorated from start date. Clawback: pro-rata repayment if revoked and proceeds withheld for taxes as required. Sending to Legal + Comp for wording.
Leah (Hiring Manager): I'll write the business justification and ping VP Eng for expedited sign-off. I can fund additional hiring discretionary budget for any cash sign-on if needed.
Maya (Comp): I'll prepare exception memo and recommend 60-day provisional window. If VP approves, Comp will finalize the quantity and Finance will align payroll/equity admin.
VP Eng: On board if Comp and Legal clear wording and Finance confirms accounting impact. Approving provisional grant for 60 days.
Payroll: Note payroll cutoff May 2 for first run; confirm enrollment dates to candidate to avoid mismatch. Equity admin needs notification by May 5 to issue provisional grant.
Ethan (Recruiter): I'll tell candidate we have provisional approval pending final paperwork and expect final confirmation by tomorrow AM. Will share provisional clause language once Legal sends it.
Anya (People Ops): Logging this exception to tracker with redacted docs. Will follow up with candidate messaging: "provisional grant pending approvals" so they can give notice.
